title: The Punisher
synopsis: The avenging angel of Marvel Comics fame comes brilliantly to life in this searing action-adventure thriller! Dolph Lundgren stars as Frank Castle, a veteran cop who loses his entire family to a mafia car bomb. His ex-partner believes Castle survived the blast and became the Punisher, living in the sewers and exacting vigilante violence against mob bosses throughout the city. When the populace is caught in the midst of a gang war that he caused, Castle must again emerge from the shadows and save the innocent.

title: X-Men : The Animated Series - Saison 1 - 5
synopsis: The X-Men are an elite team of mutants, genetically gifted human beings with superpowers, sworn to fight for mutant rights against hostile Government agencies, whilst at the same time protecting mankind from mutant supremacist Magneto who seeks to destroy the human race in return for the atrocities committed against mutant kind.

title: Iron Man : The Animated Series - Saison 1 - 2
synopsis: Industrialist Tony Stark leads a private team of superheroes as Iron Man against the forces of evil.

title: Fantastic Four : The Animated Series - Saison 1 - 2
synopsis: When Reed Richards, Sue and Johnny Storm and pilot Ben Grimm take a premature space flight on a new shuttle, they find themselves massively bombarded with cosmic radiation. Barely managing to re-enter and land safely, the quartet find themselves forever transformed with superpowers. Deciding to use these new powers to help people, they form the Fantastic Four, a superhero team dedicated to the protection of Earth from menaces like the Latverian King Dr. Doom and Galactus, the planet consumer.

title: Spider-Man : The Animated Series - Saison 1 - 5
synopsis: Bitten by a neogenetic spider, Peter Parker develops spider-like superpowers. He uses these to fight crime while trying to balance it with the struggles of his personal life.

title: Blade
synopsis: The Daywalker known as "Blade" — a half-vampire, half-mortal man — becomes the protector of humanity against an underground army of vampires.

title: X-Men
synopsis: A drifter with a metal skeleton and a runaway who drains life on touch fall in with Xavier's school, just as Magneto starts a machine to mutate the world's leaders.

title: Blade II
synopsis: Blade forms an uneasy alliance with the vampire council in order to combat the Reapers, who are feeding on vampires.

title: Daredevil
synopsis: By day, blind attorney Matt Murdock toils for justice in Hell's Kitchen. By night, he's Daredevil, The Man Without Fear - a powerful, masked vigilante stalking the dark streets with an uncanny "radar sense" that allows him to "see" with superhuman capabilities. But when the love of his life, fiery Elektra Natchios, is targeted by New York City's ruthless Kingpin of crime and his deadly assassin Bullseye, Daredevil may be about to meet his match.

title: X2
synopsis: A military raid on the mansion forces the X-Men and Magneto into an alliance against Colonel Stryker, the man who built Wolverine.

title: The Punisher
synopsis: When undercover FBI agent Frank Castle's wife and son are slaughtered, he becomes 'the Punisher' -- a ruthless vigilante willing to go to any length to avenge his family.

title: Blade: Trinity
synopsis: For years, Blade has fought against the vampires in the cover of the night. But now, after falling into the crosshairs of the FBI, he is forced out into the daylight, where he is driven to join forces with a clan of human vampire hunters he never knew existed—The Nightstalkers. Together with Abigail and Hannibal, two deftly trained Nightstalkers, Blade follows a trail of blood to the ancient creature that is also hunting him—the original vampire, Dracula.

title: Elektra
synopsis: Elektra the warrior survives a near-death experience, becomes an assassin-for-hire, and tries to protect her two latest targets, a single father and his young daughter, from a group of supernatural assassins.

title: Fantastic Four
synopsis: During a space voyage, four scientists are altered by cosmic rays: Reed Richards gains the ability to stretch his body; Sue Storm can become invisible; Johnny Storm controls fire; and Ben Grimm is turned into a super-strong … thing. Together, these "Fantastic Four" must now thwart the evil plans of Dr. Doom and save the world from certain destruction.

title: X-Men: The Last Stand
synopsis: A pharmaceutical 'cure' for mutation splits the species in two while Jean Grey returns as the Phoenix.

title: Blade: The Series
synopsis: Blade is a half_man, half-vampire who employs his extraordinary powers in a crusade to save mankind from the demonic creatures who walk the night. Set in Detroit, Blade investigates the vampire house of Chthon. Along the way he forms an uneasy alliance with Krista Starr, a former military veteran who becomes entrenched in the world of vampires while investigating the murder of her twin brother.

title: Fantastic Four: Rise of the Silver Surfer
synopsis: The Fantastic Four return to the big screen as a new and all powerful enemy threatens the Earth. The seemingly unstoppable 'Silver Surfer', but all is not what it seems and there are old and new enemies that pose a greater threat than the intrepid superheroes realize.

title: Iron Man
synopsis: After being held captive in an Afghan cave, billionaire engineer Tony Stark creates a unique weaponized suit of armor to fight evil.

title: The Incredible Hulk
synopsis: Scientist Bruce Banner scours the planet for an antidote to the unbridled force of rage within him: the Hulk. But when the military masterminds who dream of exploiting his powers force him back to civilization, he finds himself coming face to face with a new, deadly foe.

title: Punisher: War Zone
synopsis: Waging his one-man war on the world of organized crime, ruthless vigilante-hero Frank Castle sets his sights on overeager mob boss Billy Russoti. After Russoti is left horribly disfigured by Castle, he sets out for vengeance under his new alias: Jigsaw. With the "Punisher Task Force" hot on his trail and the FBI unable to take Jigsaw in, Frank must stand up to the formidable army that Jigsaw has recruited before more of his evil deeds go unpunished.

title: X-Men Origins: Wolverine
synopsis: After seeking to live a normal life after 200 years, Logan sets out to avenge a death by undergoing the mutant Weapon X program and becoming Wolverine.

title: Iron Man 2
synopsis: With the world now aware of his dual life as the armored superhero Iron Man, billionaire inventor Tony Stark faces pressure from the government, the press and the public to share his technology with the military. Unwilling to let go of his invention, Stark, with Pepper Potts and James 'Rhodey' Rhodes at his side, must forge new alliances – and confront powerful enemies.

title: Thor
synopsis: Against his father Odin's will, The Mighty Thor — a powerful but arrogant warrior god — recklessly reignites an ancient war. Thor is cast down to Earth and forced to live among humans as punishment. Once here, Thor learns what it takes to be a true hero when the most dangerous villain of his world sends the darkest forces of Asgard to invade Earth.

title: X-Men: First Class
synopsis: Before Charles Xavier and Erik Lensherr took the names Professor X and Magneto, they were two young men discovering their powers for the first time. Before they were arch-enemies, they were closest of friends, working together with other mutants (some familiar, some new), to stop the greatest threat the world has ever known.

title: Captain America: The First Avenger
synopsis: During World War II, Steve Rogers is a sickly man from Brooklyn who's transformed into super-soldier Captain America to aid in the war effort. Rogers must stop the Red Skull – Adolf Hitler's ruthless head of weaponry, and the leader of an organization that intends to use a mysterious device of untold powers for world domination.

title: Marvel One-Shot: The Consultant
synopsis: Agent Coulson informs Agent Sitwell that the World Security Council wishes Emil Blonsky to be released from prison to join the Avengers Initiative. As Nick Fury doesn't want to release Blonsky, the two agents decide to send a patsy to sabotage the meeting...

title: Marvel One-Shot: A Funny Thing Happened on the Way to Thor's Hammer
synopsis: Agent Coulson stops at a convenience store and deals with a coincidental robbery during his visit.

title: The Avengers
synopsis: When an unexpected enemy emerges and threatens global safety and security, Nick Fury, director of the international peacekeeping agency known as S.H.I.E.L.D., finds himself in need of a team to pull the world back from the brink of disaster. Spanning the globe, a daring recruitment effort begins!

title: Marvel One-Shot: Item 47
synopsis: Benny and Claire, a down_on_their_luck couple, find a discarded Chitauri weapon referred to as 'Item 47'.

title: Iron Man 3
synopsis: Post-New York panic attacks and a stolen mansion leave Tony with nothing but a broken suit and his own head.

title: The Wolverine
synopsis: Summoned to Japan by a dying man he once saved, Logan is offered mortality — and loses his healing factor mid_war between yakuza and family.

title: Marvel's Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. — Season 1
synopsis: Season one begins where the “Marvel's The Avengers” left off. It's just after the battle of New York, and now that the existence of superheroes and aliens has become public knowledge, the world is trying to come to grips with this new reality. Agent Phil Coulson is back in action and now has his eye on a mysterious group called The Rising Tide. In order to track this unseen, unknown enemy, he has assembled a small, highly select group of Agents from the worldwide law-enforcement organization known as S.H.I.E.L.D.

title: Marvel One_Shot: Agent Carter
synopsis: Agent Peggy Carter is relegated to a desk job and frustrated at her male boss and comrades' sexist dismissal of her place in the SSR. Ordered to work late one night, Carter gets an alert that the villain Zodiac has been spotted and decides to take care of it herself.

title: Thor: The Dark World
synopsis: The Aether resurfaces, Frigga dies, and Loki fakes his own death to take Asgard's throne.

title: Captain America: The Winter Soldier
synopsis: Hydra has been growing inside S.H.I.E.L.D. for seventy years, and its best weapon is Steve's oldest friend.

title: X-Men: Days of Future Past
synopsis: Logan's mind is sent back to 1973 to stop Mystique killing Trask, the assassination that hands the Sentinel programme its blank cheque.

title: Guardians of the Galaxy
synopsis: Five criminals steal an Infinity Stone from Ronan and, to everyone's surprise, decide to save Xandar.

title: Marvel's Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. — Season 2
synopsis: In the second season, Coulson and his team look to restore trust from the government and public following S.H.I.E.L.D.'s collapse.

title: Marvel's Agent Carter — Season 1
synopsis: It's 1946, and peace has dealt Peggy Carter a serious blow as she finds herself marginalized when the men return home from fighting abroad. Working for the covert SSR (Strategic Scientific Reserve), Peggy must balance doing administrative work and going on secret missions for Howard Stark all while trying to navigate life as a single woman in America, in the wake of losing the love of her life — Steve Rogers.

title: Marvel's Daredevil — Season 1
synopsis: Blinded as a young boy, Matt Murdock fights injustice by day as a lawyer and by night as the superhero Daredevil in Hell's Kitchen, New York City.

title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
synopsis: Tony's peacekeeping program decides peace means no people, and Sokovia pays for it.

title: WHIH Newsfront — Season 1
synopsis: WHIH Newsfront is a television program presented by Christine Everhart in the WHIH World News network, informing about major events from political, scientific, and entertainment news, in the Marvel Cinematic Universe.

title: Ant-Man
synopsis: An ex_con burglar inherits a shrinking suit and pulls off a heist to keep it out of Hydra's hands.

title: Marvel's Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. — Season 3
synopsis: Many months after their war with a rogue group of Inhumans, the team is still reeling. Coulson is again trying to put the pieces of his once revered organization back together while also dealing with the loss of his hand. His confidante and second in command, Agent Melinda May, has yet to return from an impromptu vacation with ex-husband Andrew; deadly superspy Agent Bobbi Morse is recovering from her traumatic torture at the hands of Grant Ward; Fitz is obsessed with discovering the truth behind the mysterious disappearance of Simmons; and all are on high-alert for the next move from Ward and Hydra.

title: Marvel's Jessica Jones — Season 1
synopsis: After a tragic ending to her short_lived super hero stint, Jessica Jones is rebuilding her personal life and career as a detective who gets pulled into cases involving people with extraordinary abilities in New York City.

title: Marvel's Agent Carter — Season 2
synopsis: Dedicated to the fight against new Atomic Age threats in the wake of World War II, Peggy must now journey from New York City to Los Angeles and she's about to find out that the bright lights of the post-war Hollywood mask a more sinister threat to everyone she is sworn to protect.

title: Deadpool
synopsis: A terminal mercenary is tortured into a healing factor and a ruined face, then hunts the man who did it while narrating to the audience.

title: Marvel's Daredevil — Season 2
synopsis: Dark forces are tearing Hell's Kitchen apart once again, but this time Daredevil may have to choose between the city and his friends.

title: WHIH Newsfront — Season 2
synopsis: WHIH Newsfront is a television program presented by Christine Everhart in the WHIH World News network, informing about major events from political, scientific, and entertainment news, in the Marvel Cinematic Universe.

title: Captain America: Civil War
synopsis: The Sokovia Accords split the Avengers, and Zemo finishes them with a thirty_year_old tape.

title: X-Men: Apocalypse
synopsis: The first mutant wakes after five millennia, takes four horsemen and decides the modern world should be swept away.

title: Team Thor
synopsis: Discover what Thor was up to during the events of Captain America: Civil War.

title: Marvel's Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. — Season 4
synopsis: Vengeance runs rampant this season as Coulson is a mere agent again, and Daisy has gone rogue after being under Hive's control. How will S.H.I.E.L.D. deal with the arrival of The Ghost Rider?

title: Marvel's Luke Cage — Season 1
synopsis: Given superstrength and durability by a sabotaged experiment, a wrongly accused man escapes prison to become a superhero for hire.

title: Doctor Strange
synopsis: A ruined surgeon finds Kamar-Taj, loses his hands' worth of arrogance, and bargains with Dormammu.

title: Marvel's Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.: Slingshot
synopsis: Elena "Yo-Yo" Rodriguez, an Inhuman with the ability to move at super-speed, is required to sign the Sokovia Accords. However, the restrictions of the Accords are in direct conflict with a personal mission she's desperate to fulfill, one that will test her abilities and will include tense encounters with S.H.I.E.L.D. team members.

title: Team Thor: Part 2
synopsis: A continuation of the documentary spoof of what Thor and his roommate Darryl were up to during the events of "Captain America: Civil War". While Cap and Iron Man duke it out, Thor tries to pay Darryl his rent in Asgardian coins.

title: Logan
synopsis: A poisoned, ageing Logan drives a failing Xavier across a border_country America, escorting a silent girl grown from his own genes.

title: Marvel's Iron Fist — Season 1
synopsis: Fifteen years after being presumed dead in a plane crash, Danny Rand mysteriously returns to New York City determined to reclaim his birthright and family company. However, when a long-destined enemy rises in New York, this living weapon is forced to choose between his family’s legacy and his duties as the Iron Fist.

title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2
synopsis: Quill meets his father, a living planet, and learns what a father actually is from Yondu instead.

title: Spider-Man: Homecoming
synopsis: Peter wants to be an Avenger; the Vulture wants to sell alien tech; the homecoming date's father is the Vulture.

title: Marvel's The Defenders
synopsis: Daredevil, Jessica Jones, Luke Cage and Iron Fist join forces to take on common enemies as a sinister conspiracy threatens New York City.

title: Marvel's Inhumans
synopsis: After the Royal Family of Inhumans is splintered by a military coup, they barely escape to Hawaii where their surprising interactions with the lush world and humanity around them may prove to not only save them, but Earth itself.

title: Thor: Ragnarok
synopsis: Thor is imprisoned on the other side of the universe and finds himself in a race against time to get back to Asgard to stop Ragnarok, the destruction of his home_world and the end of Asgardian civilization, at the hands of a powerful new threat, the ruthless Hela.

title: Marvel's The Punisher — Season 1
synopsis: A former Marine out to punish the criminals responsible for his family's murder finds himself ensnared in a military conspiracy.

title: Marvel's Runaways — Season 1
synopsis: Every teenager thinks their parents are evil. What if you found out they actually were? Six diverse teenagers who can barely stand each other must unite against a common foe – their parents.

title: Marvel's Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. — Season 5
synopsis: Agent Coulson and the team escaped LMD Aida’s Framework and awakened in the real world. Little did they know that Aida was now fully human – and with multiple Inhuman abilities – with the dangerous notion that, with Fitz by her side, she could change the world. After defeating her with the aid of Ghost Rider, the team went out for a celebration but were interrupted by a mysterious man who rendered them frozen. The next thing we see is Coulson onboard a ship … in space. Coulson will discover that some, but not all, of his S.H.I.E.L.D. colleagues were taken with him and placed onboard the ship. As they come in contact with some of the vessel’s inhabitants, it becomes abundantly clear that something has gone terribly awry, and the team will need to figure out their role and delve deeper into this nightmarish mystery to try to right what has gone incredibly wrong.

title: Black Panther
synopsis: T'Challa takes the throne and Killmonger forces Wakanda to answer for the centuries it stayed hidden.

title: Team Darryl
synopsis: Fresh off being unseated as the ruler of Sakaar, the Grandmaster makes his way to Earth to start a new life. It's been over a year since Thor left Australia and Darryl has been struggling to pay his rent. Now Darryl needs a new roommate to help make the monthly payments. Unfortunately for Darryl, the Grandmaster was the only one who answered Darryl's "Roommate Needed" ad and with no viable options, the Grandmaster moves in.

title: Marvel's Jessica Jones — Season 2
synopsis: Drowning in anger, Jessica Jones is forced to reckon with her past, her powers and her newfound fame as she dishes out her own messy form of justice. Finally ready to face her past, Jessica hunts down the source of her powers and uncovers a link to a shadowy killer who's terrorizing the city.

title: Avengers: Infinity War
synopsis: Thanos collects all six stones and half of everything dies, including most of the people trying to stop him.

title: Deadpool 2
synopsis: Wade assembles X-Force to keep a furious mutant boy away from Cable, a soldier from the future who came back to kill him.

title: Marvel's Cloak & Dagger — Season 1
synopsis: Two teenagers from very different backgrounds awaken to newly acquired superpowers which mysteriously link them to one another.

title: Marvel's Luke Cage — Season 2
synopsis: As his fame and responsibility soar, Luke Cage finds his life upended by a mysterious newcomer with powers of his own -- and a plan to take over Harlem.

title: Ant-Man and the Wasp
synopsis: Under house arrest, Scott helps the Pyms pull Janet out of the Quantum Realm — and gets stranded there.

title: Marvel's Iron Fist — Season 2
synopsis: As a gang war brews in New York's Chinatown, Danny and Colleen strive to protect the innocent while battling fearsome enemies both old and new.

title: Venom
synopsis: A disgraced reporter is bonded to a symbiote that wants to eat people and, failing that, tater tots.

title: Marvel's Daredevil — Season 3
synopsis: Missing for months, Matt Murdock reemerges a broken man, putting into question his future as both vigilante Daredevil and lawyer Matthew Murdock. But when his archenemy Wilson Fisk is released from prison, Matt must choose between hiding from the world, or embracing his destiny as a hero.

title: Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse
synopsis: Brooklyn teen Miles Morales is bitten, and Fisk's collider drops five other Spider-People on him.

title: Marvel's Runaways — Season 2
synopsis: The Runaways have left their homes (and evil parents) behind and now have to learn to live on their own. As they scavenge for food, search for shelter, and take care of one another, our kids begin to realize that, for better or worse, they’re stuck with each other. And it’s up to them to take down PRIDE once and for all. But someone sent a mysterious message to Jonah… Is there a mole in the Runaways? Meanwhile PRIDE is focused on finding their children, and Jonah has his own dangerous plan in mind.

title: Marvel's The Punisher — Season 2
synopsis: Frank strives to protect a teenager caught in a sinister conspiracy while doing whatever it takes -- and then some -- to end Russo once and for all.

title: Captain Marvel
synopsis: Vers learns she was Air Force pilot Carol Danvers and ends the Kree-Skrull war she was fighting on the wrong side of.

title: Marvel's Cloak & Dagger — Season 2
synopsis: Season two turns the heat up on our young heroes as Tyrone and Tandy try to find their place as more active heroes in this world. As they learn and grow emotionally, so will their skills. With enhanced powers and a decision to make about the type of heroes they want to be, they make the choice to run into the danger, head first. They tackle a heartless vigilante and uncover an evil that’s been preying on the young women of the city, as the show takes on more serious topics like gang violence and human trafficking.

title: Avengers: Endgame
synopsis: Five years on, a time heist undoes the Snap and costs the Avengers their two founders.

title: Marvel's Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. — Season 6
synopsis: Last season, the team leaped forward in time to a dystopian future they soon realized must be prevented. While facing multiple timelines and new enemies from faraway planets, they found family, friends, teammates and the courage to pull off their biggest challenge yet. Their next challenge? Coming to grips with the knowledge that bending the laws of space and time may have saved the planet, but it couldn’t save Fitz or Coulson.

title: Dark Phoenix
synopsis: A rescue in orbit fills Jean with a cosmic force that unpicks Xavier's conditioning, and the team fractures over whether to save her or stop her.

title: Marvel's Jessica Jones — Season 3
synopsis: Jessica matches wits with a calculating serial killer, and a newly powered Trish goes to extremes to stamp out evil.

title: Spider-Man: Far From Home
synopsis: On a school trip through Europe, Peter hands Stark's glasses to a man who has been lying the whole time.

title: Peter's To-Do List
synopsis: On the eve of his departure to Europe, Peter Parker tells Ned Leeds that he has several things to do before they leave.

title: Marvel's Runaways — Season 3
synopsis: The Runaways frantically search for their captured friends Chase, Gert and Karolina. The kids go head to head with an unstoppable enemy who has targeted Leslie - or more accurately, the child she's carrying. Nico draws them all into a dark realm where its ruler Morgan le Fay, is much more nefarious than anyone the kids have yet to face.

title: Marvel's Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. — Season 7
synopsis: Coulson and the Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. are thrust backward in time and stranded in 1931 New York City. With the all-new Zephyr set to time-jump at any moment, the team must hurry to find out exactly what happened. If they fail, it would mean disaster for the past, present and future of the world.

title: The New Mutants
synopsis: Five teenage mutants are held in a secure hospital that turns out to be feeding on their worst memories.

title: Helstrom
synopsis: Daimon and Ana Helstrom are the son and daughter of a mysterious and powerful serial killer. The siblings have a complicated dynamic as they track down the terrorizing worst of humanity — each with their attitude and skills.

title: WandaVision
synopsis: Wanda Maximoff and Vision—two super-powered beings living idealized suburban lives—begin to suspect that everything is not as it seems.

title: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
synopsis: Following the events of “Avengers: Endgame”, the Falcon, Sam Wilson and the Winter Soldier, Bucky Barnes team up in a global adventure that tests their abilities, and their patience.

title: Loki — Season 1
synopsis: A variant Loki is arrested by the TVA and finds the man behind the Sacred Timeline.

title: Black Widow
synopsis: On the run after Civil War, Natasha reunites with her fake family to burn down the Red Room.

title: What If...? — Season 1
synopsis: Taking inspiration from the comic books of the same name, each episode of this animated anthology series questions, revisits and twists classic Marvel Cinematic moments.

title: Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings
synopsis: A San Francisco valet is really the son of the Mandarin, and the Ten Rings want him home.

title: Venom: Let There Be Carnage
synopsis: Serial killer Cletus Kasady gets a symbiote of his own, and Eddie has to make up with his.

title: Eternals
synopsis: Ten immortals who sat out every Marvel event explain why, then stop a planet from hatching.

title: Hawkeye
synopsis: Clint just wants to be home for Christmas; Kate Bishop and the Tracksuit Mafia disagree.

title: Spider-Man: No Way Home
synopsis: A botched forgetting spell pulls in villains from other universes, and ends with nobody remembering Peter Parker.

title: Moon Knight
synopsis: A London gift_shop clerk keeps losing days to a mercenary who shares his body and works for a moon god.

title: Morbius
synopsis: A biochemist cures his blood disease with bat DNA and gets vampirism as the side effect.

title: Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness
synopsis: America Chavez can punch holes between universes, and Wanda wants that power to reach her sons.

title: Ms. Marvel
synopsis: A Jersey City fangirl finds a family bangle that makes hard light, and a Partition_era secret behind it.

title: Thor: Love and Thunder
synopsis: Gorr is killing gods, Jane is dying, and Mjolnir has picked someone new.

title: I Am Groot — Season 1
synopsis: There's no guarding the galaxy from this mischievous toddler! Get ready as Baby Groot takes center stage in his very own collection of shorts, exploring his glory days growing up and getting into trouble among the stars.

title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
synopsis: Jen gets her cousin's blood, his powers, and a superhuman law practice she never asked for.

title: Werewolf by Night
synopsis: On a dark and somber night, a secret cabal of monster hunters emerge from the shadows and gather at the foreboding Bloodstone Temple following the death of their leader. In a strange and macabre memorial to the leader’s life, the attendees are thrust into a mysterious and deadly competition for a powerful relic—a hunt that will ultimately bring them face to face with a dangerous monster.

title: Black Panther: Wakanda Forever
synopsis: Wakanda mourns T'Challa while Namor's Talokan declares war on the surface over vibranium.

title: The Guardians of the Galaxy Holiday Special
synopsis: On a mission to make Christmas unforgettable for Quill, the Guardians head to Earth in search of the perfect present.

title: Marvel's Moon Girl and Devil Dinosaur — Season 1
synopsis: After 13-year-old super-genius Lunella accidentally brings ten-ton T-Rex, Devil Dinosaur into present-day New York City via a time vortex, the duo works together to protect the city's Lower East Side from danger.

title: Ant-Man and the Wasp: Quantumania
synopsis: The whole Lang-Pym family falls into the Quantum Realm, where Janet's old enemy is waiting.

title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
synopsis: Rocket is dying, so the team robs the man who made him. It is his story, not Quill's.

title: Spider-Man: Across the Spider-Verse
synopsis: Miles meets a whole society of Spider-People who tell him his story has to end a certain way.

title: The Spider Within: A Spider-Verse Story
synopsis: After a particularly challenging day, Miles experiences a panic attack that forces him to confront the manifestations of his anxiety and learn that reaching out for help can be just as brave an act as protecting his city from evil.

title: Secret Invasion
synopsis: The Skrulls Fury promised a home to have run out of patience and are wearing everyone's faces.

title: I Am Groot — Season 2
synopsis: The troublemaking twig returns to mischief in the second season of “I Am Groot.” This time, Baby Groot finds himself exploring the universe and beyond aboard the Guardians' spaceships, coming face-to-face—or nose-to-nose—with new and colorful creatures and environments.

title: Loki — Season 2
synopsis: The TVA is coming apart and Loki learns to hold the whole multiverse together himself.

title: The Marvels
synopsis: Carol, Monica and Kamala keep swapping places mid_fight, which is a problem when a Kree wants revenge.

title: What If...? — Season 2
synopsis: Season two continues the journey as The Watcher guides viewers through the vast multiverse, introducing brand new and familiar faces throughout the MCU.

title: Echo
synopsis: Maya Lopez goes home to Oklahoma to get away from Fisk and finds her Choctaw ancestors instead.

title: Marvel's Moon Girl and Devil Dinosaur — Season 2
synopsis: In season 2, Moon Girl and Devil Dinosaur are in their element as Super Heroes; however, as Moon Girl's Super Hero-ing intertwines more with her personal life, she must decide if the cost of keeping her identity a secret is worth the toll it takes on her family.

title: Madame Web
synopsis: A New York paramedic starts seeing the future and has to keep three teenagers from dying in it.

title: X-Men '97 — Season 1
synopsis: Picking up where 'X-Men' left off, the X-Men are in a period of transition, struggling with the loss of Professor X. And while their world is in a strained state of calm when it comes to mutant-human relations—everyone knows that's likely temporary.

title: Deadpool & Wolverine
synopsis: The TVA prunes Wade's universe, so he drags the worst Wolverine he can find out of the Void to fix it.

title: Agatha All Along
synopsis: Freed from her Westview spell, Agatha walks the Witches' Road with a teenager who is not what he says.

title: Kraven the Hunter
synopsis: Sergei Kravinoff turns his father's hunting lessons on the criminals his father worked with.

title: What If...? — Season 3
synopsis: Season 3 follows classic characters as they make unexpected choices that will mutate their worlds into spectacular alternate versions of the MCU.

title: Your Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man — Season 1
synopsis: A rebooted origin in which a teenage Peter learns the job under Norman Osborn's patronage.

title: Captain America: Brave New World
synopsis: President Ross wants Sam's Avengers; the adamantium on Celestial Island and Ross's own blood have other plans.

title: Daredevil: Born Again
synopsis: Matt hangs up the horns and Fisk runs for mayor. Neither retirement lasts.

title: Thunderbolts*
synopsis: Valentina's disposable killers are set up to kill each other, and the man they find in the vault is worse than all of them.

title: Ironheart
